description: Triggering and behavior evals for the question-coach skill.
should_trigger: run my question coach for this week
score this 1:1 transcript for open vs closed questions
grade my questioning in this meeting
give me some closed-to-open question drills before my 1:1
did I follow the thread in this conversation?
am I ready to advance to phase 2?
here's my 1:1 transcript — how was my questioning?
role-play a 1:1 so I can practice asking open questions
log this week's question practice and check the gate
should_not_trigger: give me swing trade ideas for this week
write a social post for Nyra day 5
behavior_checks: Quotes each manager question verbatim before classifying it
Classifies STATEMENT-AS-QUESTION against the user, not as open
Computes open ratio as OPEN / total questions
Flags a high open ratio that surfaced nothing new as a failure
Gives exactly one surgical rewrite, not a long list
Checks the Phase-1 to Phase-2 gate: open ratio >= 60% AND >= 3/4 labs surfaced something new for 2 consecutive weeks
Flags Week 5 gate misses as a method problem, not a timeline problem
Never invents transcript content; asks for a fuller dump if too thin
